issues: Covers and spend per head both rose week on week.
Sales were ahead of last week and ahead of target.
No intangibles audit was done this week.
The GM and head chef notes link in the KPI report still points to the notes for 01/06/2026 to 07/06/2026.
The Deliveroo, labour, operational food cost, food and drinks variance and staff update sections of the KPI report were left blank.
The site only ran out of a few items this week rather than running short on a lot of stock.
The pass has worked very well from the front of house side, and delivery orders went out quickly and consistently.
Arguments in the kitchen were raised and have been addressed by the head chef, Roger.
Delivery orders are not always going out with cutlery.
The only poor in house reviews related to front of house service, where a table asked for water twice without being helped.
Deliveroo reviews were mostly positive, with a small number of one star reviews.
Staff are kept late on busier days when needed and the site is starting to send staff home early when they are not needed.
Hiring is open for one back of house hot side role, two new sushi starters have been hired, front of house needs a few staff and the bar needs two.
Staff lateness is handled with a sit down conversation after two late arrivals.
The kitchen is deep cleaned every day to keep on top of a pest problem, and contractors are coming to seal any holes pests can use to get in.
The prep fridge has been fixed, but the chefs are concerned it may fail again and PAT testing is noted.
The waste log is completed daily by the kitchen team.
The Kobas rota and the rota tool are both completed, and the budget is reducing week by week as expected.
A True Social event is upcoming and details on the food arrangements are still to be passed on.
